recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies FHIR-15666 after accounting for the later Specimen.focus refactor; no core follow-up is needed for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-15666 was a Published OO change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to add Location as an allowed Specimen.subject reference target and to adjust the subject description for environmental samples.
initial_application: The issue was applied in 2018: commit 6a1430471a added Location to the Specimen.subject reference list, commit 68d00fb715 updated the subject definition wording, and the 2021 XML source migration in 33b409a4b6 preserved that state.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issues FHIR-53384 and FHIR-56301 changed the subject/focus model for R6 but retained Location as a possible Specimen.subject target; both related issues already have reconcile commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml defines Specimen.subject with Location in the targetProfile list and text saying the subject may be a location, and the SpecimenDefinition $apply operation also lists Location as a possible subject.
